title: Let's Do It Already!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Free-spirited Yuri falls for straitlaced Keiichiro on their daily commute, and he returns her feelings. His political family, a line of prime ministers, forbids its sons any sexual relations before 18, so the physically affectionate couple must keep things chaste. The romantic comedy plays on the tension between her eagerness and his family's rule.
life_message: Love can grow through patience and respect for boundaries, even when desire runs ahead.
